title.narrative: Advancing Scientific & Environmental Education in Ecuadorian Biosphere Reserves

description.narrative: In the Chocó Andino BR, the project will strengthen the successful experience of the Bosques Escuela and contribute to the development of a contextualized ESD program on biodiversity conservation, climate change risks, and sustainable agriculture to be implemented with rural school students where experiential environmental education is continuously supported. In addition, this ESD program will become a useful tool for teachers to strengthen climate change teaching capacities. In the Sumaco BR, contextualized materials to the Amazon rainforest will also be created on the same topics of conservation, biodiversity and climate change risks. Additionally, we will try to include activities inside the forest in coordination with the Sumaco National Park rangers to encourage critical and experiential thinking. Because some of the children are located in very remote communities, a "traveling backpacks" program will be implemented, in which educational materials focused on climate change and climate action will be loaned on a rotating basis. There are also plans for an "itinerant caravan" where 2 or 3 communities will be visited with a one-day program with educational activities on the environment and climate change through performing arts such as theater, storytelling and music. The methodology and results of these processes will be socialized and shared with the rest of the Bosque Escuela in the Chocó Andino BR and with the children of the Sumaco BR to see if they can be replicated in other BRs in Ecuador.
